stories.headline: Biscuit Joins Diego's Family Tuesday
stories.article: Diego adopted a puppy from the shelter on Tuesday. The puppy is named Biscuit.

stories.headline: Biscuit Conquers Zilker Park Saturday Morning
stories.article: Diego took Biscuit for a walk on Saturday morning. They went to Zilker Park together.

panels.scene: Inside animal shelter, Diego crouched down meeting a small puppy, smiling warmly, front angle, adoption counter in background
panels.caption: Tuesday brought a very important adoption.

panels.scene: Outside shelter doorway in daylight, Diego walking out with puppy Biscuit on leash, happy expression, side angle
panels.caption: One leash, one big new adventure begins.

panels.scene: Zilker Park trail on Saturday morning, open grass and trees behind, Diego walking puppy Biscuit on leash, side view, smiling
panels.caption: Saturday morning meant Zilker Park adventure time.

panels.scene: Zilker Park grassy area, Diego kneeling to pet puppy Biscuit after the walk, relaxed happy expression, eye-level angle
panels.caption: Zilker Park walk, officially approved by Biscuit.
